title: C(P)XCG Proteins of Haloferax volcanii with Predicted Zinc Finger Domains: The Majority Bind Zinc, but Several Do Not.
authors: Uresin, Deniz; Schulte, Jonathan; Morgner, Nina; Soppa, Jorg
one_liner_zh: 该文研究古菌C(P)XCG锌指蛋白的金属结合特性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关锌指结构域，但未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制，且方法以实验为主，仅用AlphaFold2预测，缺乏AI/物理模拟建模深度。
abstract: In recent years, interest in very small proteins (micro-proteins) has increased significantly, and they were found to fulfill important functions in all prokaryotic and eukaryotic species. The halophilic archaeon Haloferax volcanii encodes about 400 micro-proteins of less than 70 amino acids, 49 of which contain at least two C(P)XCG motifs and are, thus, predicted zinc finger proteins. The determination of the NMR solution structure of HVO_2753 revealed that only one of two predicted zinc fingers actually bound zinc, while a second one was metal-free. Therefore, the aim of the current study was the homologous production of additional C(P)XCG proteins and the quantification of their zinc content. Attempts to produce 31 proteins failed, underscoring the particular difficulties of working with micro-proteins. In total, 14 proteins could be produced and purified, and the zinc content was determined. Only nine proteins complexed zinc, while five proteins were zinc-free. Three of the latter could be analyzed using ESI-MS and were found to contain another metal, most likely cobalt or nickel. Therefore, at least in haloarchaea, the variability of predicted C(P)XCG zinc finger motifs is higher than anticipated, and they can be metal-free, bind zinc, or bind another metal. Notably, AlphaFold2 cannot correctly predict whether or not the four cysteines have the tetrahedral configuration that is a prerequisite for metal binding.
abstract_zh: 近年来，对极小蛋白质（微蛋白）的兴趣显著增加，并发现它们在所有原核和真核物种中承担重要功能。嗜盐古菌 *Haloferax volcanii* 编码约400种少于70个氨基酸的微蛋白，其中49种含有至少两个C(P)XCG基序，因此被预测为锌指蛋白。通过测定HVO_2753的NMR溶液结构，发现两个预测的锌指中仅有一个实际结合锌，而另一个则不含金属。因此，本研究的目的是同源生产额外的C(P)XCG蛋白并量化其锌含量。尝试生产31种蛋白的努力失败，突显了处理微蛋白的特殊困难。总共成功生产并纯化了14种蛋白，并测定了其锌含量。仅9种蛋白结合锌，而5种蛋白不含锌。其中3种可通过ESI-MS分析，发现含有另一种金属，很可能是钴或镍。因此，至少在盐古菌中，预测的C(P)XCG锌指基序的变异性高于预期，它们可以不含金属、结合锌或结合其他金属。值得注意的是，AlphaFold2无法正确预测四个半胱氨酸是否具有金属结合所必需的四面体构型。
